subject.title: fix(message): ignore populated location on text sends

question: Should `normalizeMessageActionRequest` become a supported public Channel Plugin SDK contract for owner-controlled post-authorization action rewriting, or should this Telegram repair use a narrower approved seam?
rationale: The implementation deliberately regenerates the public Plugin SDK API baseline and changes generic dispatcher lifecycle behavior; code review cannot safely choose the permanent external-plugin contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Define and approve the SDK contract
options.body: Document the hook’s authorization, validation, action-rewrite, and compatibility guarantees, then accept it as a supported Plugin SDK surface.

options.title: Use a narrower approved seam
options.body: Keep the Telegram producer-side repair but replace the broad public rewrite hook with a limited contract that owners explicitly endorse.

recommendation.title: Use a narrower approved seam
recommendation.body: Keep the Telegram producer-side repair but replace the broad public rewrite hook with a limited contract that owners explicitly endorse.

likelyOwner.reason: A channel/plugin-SDK owner must decide the permanent external contract; supplied context does not identify a concrete current-main owner.
